sources.title: McGill-NLP/AfriqueQwen3.5-4B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: AfriqueQwen3.5-4B is part of the AfriqueLLM suite—a collection of open language models adapted to 20 African languages through continued pre-training (CPT) on ~26B tokens. This model is based on Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B-Base and has been specifically adapted for improved performance on African languages ...

sources.snippet: The checkpoint declares Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration but carries no vision weights (426 language-model tensors plus a tied lm_head copy, 0 visual), so --language-model-only is required.
